categories.main_business_segments: EVA Airways Corporation primarily operates in aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) services, including airframe, engine, and component maintenance. It also engages in manufacturing and sales of aircraft components and parts, as well as civil aviation personnel training. The company has two main divisions: the maintenance division and the manufacturing division, serving both domestic and international customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced aerospace technologies including composite material repair, precision machining, metal surface treatment, non-destructive testing, and automated assembly lines. It holds over 65 aerospace special process certifications including NADCAP and integrates AI, IoT, and visualization technologies for smart manufacturing. The manufacturing processes include mechanical processing, aluminum alloy machining, special processes, and assembly of structural components and engine parts.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major international airlines such as EVA Airways, All Nippon Airways, UPS Airlines, Western Global Airlines, Austrian Airlines, and Peach Aviation. The company serves commercial aircraft operators globally, with approximately 70% of revenue from international clients. It also supplies major aerospace OEMs like Boeing and GE Aviation with aircraft components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with facilities in Taoyuan City and Guanyin District. Its customer base and markets span Asia, North America, Europe, and other regions, with significant sales in Taiwan, Asia, North America, and Europe. It holds certifications from aviation authorities in the US, Europe, Japan, and Korea, enabling global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: EVA Airways Corporation operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace supply chain, providing MRO services and manufacturing aircraft components. It collaborates closely with OEMs like Boeing and GE Aviation, acting as a key supplier and maintenance provider within the global aerospace ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing composite material repair capabilities, expanding international MRO market share, and increasing automation in manufacturing to reduce costs. It invests in advanced manufacturing technologies such as automated EDM lines and ultrasonic inspection. Strategic R&D includes developing advanced manufacturing techniques for engine combustion components and integrating AI and IoT for smart production management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service contracts for aircraft maintenance, repair, and overhaul, as well as sales of manufactured aircraft components. The company recognizes revenue from fixed-price maintenance contracts based on service completion and product sales upon delivery. Additional income sources include rental income from investment properties and interest income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks among the top 10 global airframe MRO providers and competes with major international MRO firms such as ST Engineering Aerospace, HAECO Group, Lufthansa Technik, and AAR. It holds a strong market position in Asia and maintains close partnerships with leading OEMs, leveraging its technical expertise and certifications to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$11.85 billion, a 23.19% increase from the previous year, with net income reaching NT$1.58 billion and EPS of NT$4.48. It has a solid asset base exceeding NT$21 billion and equity of about NT$10.9 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth post-pandemic, supported by recovery in the aviation sector and expansion of manufacturing orders.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EVA Airways Corporation emphasizes safety, quality, and technical excellence, maintaining 'safety first, quality foremost' as its core mission. It offers comprehensive MRO services with global certifications and advanced composite repair capabilities. The company differentiates itself through long-term OEM partnerships, high employee expertise, and integrated manufacturing and maintenance services, providing customers with reliable, high-value aerospace solutions.
